encode_queries_with_reasonir: encode a list of search queries into dense embeddings using ReasonIRModel for retrieval tasks
encode_corpus_with_reasonir: encode a corpus of documents into dense embeddings using ReasonIRModel encode_corpus method
pool_hidden_states: apply mean or last token pooling to transformer hidden states using ReasonIRModel pooling method
run_causal_lm_forward: run a forward pass through LlamaForCausalLM to generate logits for next token prediction
build_sequence_classifier: build a sequence classification model using LlamaForSequenceClassification with a linear head on top
